title: Fellowship for Agricultural Science
summary: Individual financial support up to 10,000 EUR for MSc and PhD students in natural or data science pursuing agricultural science projects, including study, research, or internships in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Applicants are currently studying for an MSc or PhD.

subject_areas.notes: Students from all fields of natural science and data science with fundamental or applied studies with relevance to the crop science industry / agricultural science.
